sources.title: [2504.04706] AdvKT: An Adversarial Multi-Step Training Framework for ...
sources.snippet: To address these challenges, we propose a novel Adversarial Multi-Step Training Framework for Knowledge Tracing (AdvKT), which, for the first time, focuses on the multi-step KT task. More specifically, AdvKT leverages adversarial learning paradigm involving a generator and a discriminator.
